stem.text: In this question you should use changes in oxidation numbers to balance a chemical equation.
Acidified potassium dichromate(VI) solution can oxidise a solution of $\text{V}^{2+}$ ions. The equation for this reaction is shown.

stem.latex: a\,\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} + b\,\text{V}^{2+} + c\,\text{H}^{+} \rightarrow d\,\text{Cr}^{3+} + e\,\text{VO}_3^{-} + f\,\text{H}_2\text{O}

stem.text: What is the ratio $a:b$ in the correctly balanced equation?
